Scope Gate.rationale: Scope converts CKA-04 into 7 traceable scope items, 5 bounding exclusions, and 9 measurable acceptance criteria preserving both verbatim ticket criteria (A-004, A-002). D-001 selects one of the two backlog-admissible resolutions of the CKA-05 coupling with a reviewed rationale; D-002/X-004 hold the CKA-05 intake to banner presence only. Both open questions are non-blocking with owners and needed-by points; Validation Engine passed 33/33.

Planning Gate.decided_by: omn-tech-lead subagent af0fb6b9bc178d4fa, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Planning Gate.rationale: Plan decomposes all 7 scope items and 9 acceptance criteria into 8 tasks; dependency graph acyclic, 3 waves executable in order (Validation Engine 45/45 plus independent inspection). The two real risks (prohibition-phrasing false positives in the coercive scan; alias-reading divergence from producer_aliases) are owned and mitigated at design. Effort proportionate; no task violates X-001 additive-only or X-002 no-CI-config-change. Conditions: design must close Q-001, demonstrate R-005 discrimination, and bind alias logic to the runtime's own source.

Design Gate.decided_by: omn-tech-lead subagent a9​6f9b317ea024bdb, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Design Gate.rationale: All three Planning Gate conditions honored and independently verified: D-002 closes the coercive-pattern inventory behind a two-part structural discriminator with all six prohibition instances confirmed at file:line (retires R-005); D-001 binds check 1 by import to producer_aliases/parse_gate_matrix/parse_phase_model/phase_gates at their cited lines (closes R-006 by construction); C-007/D-003 pin the banner line and cross-links (closes Q-002). Feasibility grounded in the verify.yml discovery contract; change strictly additive; the checks cover A-001..A-009. Validation 78/78. ADRs D-001 and D-002 accepted. Conditions P-002..P-005 bind implementation.

Review Gate.decided_by: omn-qa subagent ac891c65650b4dfec, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Review Gate.rationale: Review package complete and independent (Validation Engine 31/31); its load-bearing executed claims reproduce on this tree (targeted module 13/13, same six itemized exclusions, self-hosting 7/8 with identical S8 itemization). Zero blocking findings: F-001's substance is already resolved on the tree - family 6 now carries D-002's third element with qualifier-bearing fixtures, verified by read and post-fix execution; F-002 is account precision only, correctly not repaired in place because M12 pins the committed report's digest. Decided as non-producer second owner under the Producer Exclusion Rule; record-at-closure disposition for CR-001 accounting and CR-002 accepted.

Verification Gate.decided_by: omn-qa subagent ac891c65650b4dfec, recorded by session operator for vuhoangcao
Verification Gate.rationale: Eight of nine acceptance criteria met on executed or directly inspected evidence (A-001..A-008 pass: CI discovery contract confirmed, suite 342 OK on this tree, structure-preserving rewording free, producer-only fixture fails in both alias directions, marker/banner/coercive fixtures all demonstrated, four banners exact); A-009 deferred to the documentation phase by the plan's own sequencing and carried as a closure condition. Conditions for closure: A-009 settlement, CR dispositions persisted, this run's change proposal landing.
